brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Build provides flat cover tops (cover:-1,0,0 etc. plus upper cover 0,0,1) that can display books as props, but configurator checks fit/collision only and does not verify materials, strength, or load ratings; parts are 3D-printed plastic per user material choice. No 50 kg rating can be claimed.
Two notch drawer frames placed: notch:0#-1,-1#notch5 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm) and notch:0#-1,1#notch0 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf), each provides a pull-out drawer compartment.

finish.summary: Built a modest 8-cell shelf base (7 cells level 0 + 1 cell level 1) with solid covers forming shelf surfaces and two notch drawer frames. Dressed with book props. Load rating is unverifiable in this system and marked unmet; you must not load with 50 kg.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
